core_obligations: Exactness at the first terms (proof lines 2854-2865): by definition mu_{n,S} is the kernel of the n-th power map, so the sequence is exact at mu_{n,S} and at the first copy of G_m.

Surjectivity (proof lines 2865-2880): for a unit over an object of the small or big etale site, invertibility of n allows an n-th root to be found on the members of an etale covering, which gives surjectivity of the last map.
Conclude for both sites (proof lines 2880-2885): the same argument applies to the small and to the big etale site, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Read exactness at the first two terms off the definition of mu_n.
Lift units to n-th roots on the members of an etale covering, using invertibility of n.
Conclude exactness on both the small and the big etale site.
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the Kummer sequence is short exact on both the small and the big etale site of S, provided n is invertible on S (statement lines 2841-2852). Exactness at the first two terms is by definition of mu_{n,S} (proof lines 2854-2865); the content is the surjectivity of the n-th power map, which uses the local existence of n-th roots of a unit on an etale covering under the invertibility hypothesis (proof lines 2865-2880), and the same argument applies on both sites (proof lines 2880-2885). The non-formal content is the local existence of roots. The claim is H2: one definitional part plus one lifting argument.
